label: Conditional truth and support
resolution: The primary claim uses Gibbard’s expressly qualified expanded full-truth sense. PLAN-STATE-EMBEDDING-CONTROL uses stipulated compositional support, whose conditional holds at a point whenever the antecedent is unsupported or consequent supported. These are not identified: Gibbard denies full truth values to false-antecedent indicative conditionals. No result here proves his indicative semantics validates MP or that the analyst clause captures his psychology or ordinary moral language.
